heading: Wednesday, November 5, 2025
topLine: RFdiffusion designs full antibodies to chosen epitopes, confirmed by cryo-EM.

items.headline: RFdiffusion designs full antibodies to chosen epitopes, confirmed by cryo-EM
items.summary: The Baker lab extended RFdiffusion to generate complete antibody variable regions, including heavy and light chains, against targets such as influenza haemagglutinin and Clostridium difficile toxin B without animal immunisation, a long-standing goal in therapeutic antibody discovery. Published in Nature: cryo-EM matched four of five tested designs to their models and the best reached mid-nanomolar affinity after maturation, which Baker calls a proof of concept rather than drug-grade binders.
